name: slotscout
description: SlotScout (slotscout.ca): check any spot in British Columbia, rule by rule, for recreational target shooting.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w @slotscout/api" "npm run dev -w @slotscout/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @slotscout/api && npm run build -w @slotscout/web
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/engine && tsc -p packages/pipeline && tsc -p apps/api && tsc -p apps/web && tsc -p scripts
